title: List hooks endpoint (GET /api/hooks)
user_story: As a user, I need to list all my webhook inboxes so I can see what hooks exist and their current status.
description: Implement GET /api/hooks to return a JSON array of all hooks. Each hook includes hook_id, name, created_at, request_count, and the ingestion URL. The list is ordered by created_at descending (newest first). A new database method list_hooks() is needed. The response includes a top-level 'hooks' key wrapping the array and a 'count' field for the total number of hooks.

acceptance_criteria.then: response is 200 with JSON containing 'hooks' array of 3 items and 'count': 3
response is 200 with JSON containing empty 'hooks' array and 'count': 0
each hook object contains hook_id, name, created_at, request_count, and url fields
hooks are ordered by created_at descending (newest first)
integration tests verify listing with 0, 1, and multiple hooks

functions.description: List all hooks ordered by created_at descending
